checks: Identical surface requests reuse the owned material.
Aliases reuse the canonical surface cache.
Different tints share the neutral original texture maps.
Repeat variants do not mutate another surface UV repetition.
Sewn rugs are cached by tint and physical aspect.
Rug borders occupy a continuous top UV region.
All generated textures meet the 512 pixel and anisotropy 8 budgets.
Base colour is sRGB and detail channels remain linear.
Source/key enrichment reuses a single clone.
Authored maps, colour and scalar material values are preserved by reference/value.
The imported source material remains unchanged.
Only missing normal and roughness channels are added to a classified surface.
Metal, eyes, generic colour and emissive materials are guarded.
Cream is classified as cloth only when its actual map is named fabric.
Unmapped cream remains authored rather than assumed cloth.
BED material wood_Classic retains its original appearance data.
BED material wood_light_Classic retains its original appearance data.
BED material gold_Classic retains its original appearance data.
BED material cream_Classic retains its original appearance data.
BED material blue_Classic retains its original appearance data.
BED material ivory_Classic retains its original appearance data.
BED material ceramic_Classic retains its original appearance data.
Actual BED GLB resolves distinct cloth, wood and ceramic from authored evidence.
Independent palettes generate byte-identical locally seeded patterns.
Final disposal releases each owned material and generated texture exactly once.
Imported textures are never disposed by the palette.
Disposed palettes release their caches.
Use after final teardown fails explicitly.
